results: Only settled exact inputs reuse the base; moving subpixel views do not allocate
Lamp geometry, gradient, intensity, order, tint, revision and interior sprites invalidate exactly
Continuous lamp changes stay on the uncached path
Room lighting, oversized buffers, unbaked geometry and custom Canvas effects use the original path
A cache owns one bounded canvas, reuses it and releases its pixels explicitly
Dynamic vehicles, projectiles and fire never enter the static cache key
Unavailable or lost cache contexts preserve the ordinary lighting path
Map changes and game reset release the old cache backing store
Garment paths are reused across characters while colors remain live
Cached garment details fit different body proportions and keep alpha/transforms
Warm static clothing creates no new paths or raster sprites
Clothing bust shapes retain separate fills and reuse outlines across colors
Detailed clothing/body timings are exclusive, scoped and restore their original functions
Hair/cloth transforms snapshot native coordinates once and reuse plain numeric fields
Limb shading reuses outline geometry and preserves collapsed-joint length
Only transformed ghost particles copy the full Canvas state
Particle order, inherited alpha, styles and transforms survive mixed draws
Culled and interpolated particles retain their existing geometry and source state
Rejects invalid starts and conflicting benches; cancellation restores diagnostic settings
Includes every simulation tick, survives profiler resets, reports stalls and overlapping sections honestly
Frame limiter skips never become extra rendered frames or halve the measured interval
Warmup and hidden/paused intervals are excluded; visible long stalls are retained
Game reset cancels capture and restores idle profiling
Detailed capture reuses entity/character/world hooks without the Full panel and restores original functions
Summary capture disables detailed hooks and cancellation restores an already visible Full profiler
Tiny dropped-time totals are distinguished from sustained simulation backlog

Legacy save/load and cap PP settlement preserve XP without duplicate payouts
Rejected Flit spends no charge, only the blocked cue; shortened landing clears the actor radius
Flit VFX draws without shadowBlur and keeps one body per spirit across frames
Held ring flick requires fresh outward speed, rearms deliberately and preserves standalone flick
Precise Stick: dead centre, gentle response curve, and steering that grows with the push
A car turned into a wall or corner can always drive away from it
Player autodrive follows connected roads and arrives without teleport
Zib autodrive follows connected roads and arrives without teleport

Player completes a passed endpoint stop on R1.S1.L2
Zib completes a passed endpoint stop on R0.S0.L2
Zib completes a passed endpoint stop on R1.S1.L2
Map-edge dead ends start no ride, keep her pin, and a failed route is free
A map switch mid-ride ends the ride uncharged, with no ghost cab
Player stopped beside the final stop arrives after a still half-second
Zib stopped beside the final stop arrives after a still half-second
Arrival without a drive route keeps the direct-distance threshold
Autodrive keyboard repeat, player takeover and passenger input guards
Closed profiler samples no clocks or reports; visible profiler and benchmark can sample
Player marker keeps CSS-pixel size, hides in special views and restores Canvas state
Mirage rings keep one quarter-resolution snapshot, at most four bends and no outlines
Every rapid-fire bullet that lands deals damage; a melee swing keeps its i-frames
Nav grid: once per tick, local invalidation, failed searches back off, steering falls back straight
Melee steps in only on a target in reach
Pause → Equip opens the Weapons tab and lists the equipped gun; furniture waits for the apartment
Adaptive lighting survives zoom lamp-budget steps and lightning
Baseline layer panel: each layer gated and billed; with Baseline off nothing is gated or counted
Velvet routes around walls without teleporting or walking through geometry
Velvet waits at unreachable routes and leaves rest when the player departs
Contact shadows stay on the ground across rotation, bobbing, vector and sprite passes
Humanoid contact and sun shadows keep their world placement as bodies turn

A landmark just off screen still throws its beams but skips its roof pass
A landmark whose body is off screen draws only its beams in the glow pass
Portico marquee: one stamp a bulb, from a sprite baked to the screen scale
Apartment lights: each lamp shade and festoon bulb is one stamp, glow and bulb together
The window city draws nothing while its strip is off screen
City view: the hub kit seen from a window; its bake leaves the camera as it found it, and each car is one stamp
City traffic: the cars on a lane share its speed, and never close on each other
City parallax: the city slides slower than the floor, never past its picture, and sits as laid out at the edge
Look-out: at the veranda edge the camera leans out over the city; nowhere else
Camera edge lock: the view stays inside the map, a narrow map is centred, and off it follows her as before
Ultra reflections: lights at half size, detail at full size and only where it has something, art at the scale it is seen
Ultra reflections: art repaints on a cadence, crowd bakes are shared and pace-proof, puddles bake once, rects never overlap
Adaptive reflections: slow frames step Ultra down to High then Medium (never Off), steady frames bring it back, the saved choice untouched

Rooftop festoons: every bulb at its own shimmer of the string, in one fill per shimmer
Landmark roofs: every painted run draws the same at any time and in any wind

Cars live on the hub: after a hijack nothing of hers is drawn, solid or offered indoors, and each is back where she left it
Out of a hijacked car: lights left on, still hers to Drive; taking another sends it back to traffic, lit, and an empty one has nobody to put out
Amber's van is sanctioned: never duplicated, parked where she leaves it, home for a new job
Her car on foot: Drive from behind or in front walks round the corner without a stall; walking into it slides along its side like any car
Markers: pins over what is on screen after the light; the compass round her for what is not; none indoors

Hijacking: a ganger at the wheel comes out fighting; a civilian, or an empty car, does not
Traffic goes round her parked car: a lane change, or a stop and an overtake when both lanes are hers; never a shove
People in the road: someone crossing is let across, someone standing is stopped for and gone round at a walk; nobody is touched

Hit by a car: 10 once, then a moment of grace, not a hit every tick it touches
